entities.name: Liu Tianhua
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Liu Tianhua was a Chinese musician and composer best known for his innovative work for the erhu. Liu's students, such as Jiang Fengzhi and Chen Zhenduo, continued to contribute to the development of the erhu.
